notes.title: New Major Update: Worlds and Crown System
notes.content:
New Content:

Worlds:
[list]
[*] A new system allows you to select one of three worlds upon sacrifice. This choice will affect the game in your next sacrifice. Additionally, you will be prompted to choose an objective. Completing the objective will reward you with Crown currency.
[/list]

Crown System:
[list]
[*] A new shop with powerful options, including the ability to gain Valor without sacrificing and increasing the maximum level of various systems in the game.
[/list]

Champion:

[list]
[*] The maximum level for the Champion is now 60 (previously 50).
[*] A new skill for the Champion has been added, which unlocks at level 60.
[/list]


Balance Changes:

[list]
[*] Increased Valor gained at all levels, with higher scaling for later levels.
[*] The maximum hits before the Supernova hit multiplier stops increasing is now 20 (previously 10).
[*] The support node that grants a percentage of treasure chest gold now gives all the gold upon the chest’s death instead of per hit (improves performance significantly with treasure chests).
[*] Bounties now scale with your total damage dealt and total gold gained, instead of a flat percentage of monster health or gold dropped.
[*] Fixed a bug where some letters in different languages were replaced with squares.
[*] Various bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Apology: Important Stats Now in Base Game
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First off, I want to apologize for my mistake in releasing a DLC with quality-of-life features that many of you feel should have been part of the base game.

I've spent countless hours over the past few months working on this update, which is the biggest one yet, packed with major content. I faced a tough decision:

[list]
[*] -Include the new content in a new DLC
[*] -Incorporate the new content into the base game and create a new DLC with visual additions (background changes) and some statistics
[/list]
I chose the latter because I wanted everyone to experience the same game. However, I underestimated the importance of the added statistics (like gold per minute and ether per hour).

I sincerely apologize for this oversight. Please accept my apologies.

Here's what I've decided to do:

[list]
[*] -Include all important statistics in the base game (such as gold per minute and ether per hour)
[*] -Keep miscellaneous statistics in the DLC (such as the number of clicks made and number of bullets fired)
[*] -Add tower skins as compensation in the current DLC
[*] -Add a champion skin as compensation in the current DLC
[*] -Every new content in the future will come with new skins that will be available through the current DLC
[/list]

Please wait some time for the changes to be added.

Thank you for your understanding and support.


Please enjoy the new expansion, and let me know your feedback.

notes.title: Second Content Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone

Firstly, I would like to extend my sincerest apologies for the delay in releasing the latest patch, initially scheduled for January. Unexpected challenges in real-life have pushed back the timeline, but I am committed to ensuring that future updates are delivered more promptly.

I am excited to share the details of the second content update for Samawa Idle, Patch 1.2.0:


[u][b]The Support Tower System:[/b][/u]
Introducing a new tower type available at around Level 300. The Support Tower is a unique tower type; it does not normally deal damage. However, this tower provides more functionality to other towers. For example, it can increase the damage a monster takes. The Support Tower can be customized using its own skill tree system.
With the help of the support tower, pushing to higher levels is now possible.

[u][b]New Tower: Ice Tower[/b][/u]
A fresh attack tower that unleashes a frostbolt at monsters. This frostbolt explodes, breaking into three ice shards, and includes a special "Frost Bomb" ability that detonates after a cooldown, inflicting substantial area damage.


[b][u]Other additions and changes:[/u][/b]

-Buying a tower after rebirth automatically adjusts increases its tier based on your current gold.
-Tower tier upgrades no longer result in a random tower selection.
-introduced a new feature allowing for the selection of towers rather than random assignment upon tier upgrades.
-A revamped effects menu offers three settings: high, low, and no effects, replacing the previous simple toggle. The effects now are displayed smartly, avoiding performance hits from excessive on-screen activity.
-(Energy Tower) Treasure Explosion now causes monsters hit by super nova to take more damage from next super nova.
-Performance has seen significant improvements, ensuring smooth gameplay even with effects enabled.
-Resolved an issue where the tower system helper was displayed incorrectly when purchasing a tower for the first time after rebirth.
-The exp bar of the workshop now shows MAX instead of Nan at the maximum level.

notes.title: First Content Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am excited to introduce the first content update for Samawa Idle, Patch 1.1.0:

[b][u]The Automator:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] The Automator plays the game for you, automating many features such as upgrading towers, buying passive abilities, retrying boss fights, looting bounties, and more.
[*] The automator system becomes available around Level 160.
[*] Every Lv. 50 boss after level 200 grants gear currency to level up the automator.
[*] The automator does not reset on rebirth.
[*] There are 8 nodes in total, each with a maximum level of 5.
[/list]

[u][b]The Rune System:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] The rune system, available around Level 100, is used for upgrading towers and enhancing workshop passives.
[*] Rune monsters, which drop valuable runes, start to spawn upon unlocking the system.
[*] There are 10 types of runes, ranging from Normal to Legendary rarity.
[*] Runes reset on rebirth.
[/list]

[u][b]The Workshop:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] The shop is now renamed the Workshop.
[*] Passives in the Workshop have various rarities, with higher rarities offering better stats.
[*] Each passive in the Workshop now has a maximum level of 10.
[*] Leveling the Workshop is now more challenging, but stat values have been doubled to maintain power levels.
[*] The maximum Workshop level is 60, achievable around Level 700+ (without %exp increases).
[/list]

[u][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Archer tower base critical chance is now 15%.
[*] Poison base damage increased by 25%.
[*] Archer Tower's Stronger Arrows max value is now 16%, with exponential cost.
[*] Archer Tower's Fast Attacks max value is now 50%.
[*] Fire Tower's Boss Killer max value is now 1791%.
[*] Lightning Tower's Weak Killer max value is now 634%, with polynomial cost.
[*] Lightning Tower's Powerful Strike max value is now 2000%, with polynomial cost.
[*] Poison Tower's Permanent Toxin changed to "Chance for Toxin to Last for 20 Seconds."
[*] Poison Tower's Knowledge Gain is replaced by Stronger Toxin.
[*] Energy Tower's Chain Reaction max value is now 6%.
[*] Energy Tower's Treasure Explosion max value is now 10%.
[*] Energy Tower's Shiny Nova max value is now 300%.
[*] Added 5 new end-game stats for further leveling progression.
[*] Adjusted costs for several end-game stats.
[/list]

[u][b]Other Changes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Added a Pin UI element in the Workshop choose menu to prevent closure when selecting stats.
[*] Added a button to lock towers, allowing random tower selection upon tier gain.
[*] Fixed a bug where treasure drops 0 gold on hit during super nova without the allocated treasure node.
[*] New content unlocks require rebirth.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.26
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.26:

[list]
[*] Added a button to refund current skill points.
[*] All skill tree nodes now have a maximum value to prevent crashes due to value overflow when using the 100x button.
[*] Re-enabled the 10x and 100x buttons on the skill tree.
[*] Added a button in the Hard Reset menu to fix and verify any negative stats. This issue was caused by the previous implementation of the 10x and 100x buttons on the skill tree.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.25
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.25 notes:

[list]
[*] Damage numbers are now colored based on the tower that dealt the damage.
[*] Performance has been significantly improved, especially when using the "Hide Effects" option.
[*] Added "10x" and "100x" options for leveling up in the skill tree.
[*] Introduced a "Next" option for leveling towers, which upgrades the tower to the next level that grants an upgrade or to the maximum level.
[*] Using the "Max" or "Next" options now displays the level you will achieve before pressing the purchase button.
[*] The setting to hide completed achievements is now saved and persists after closing the game.
[*] Fixed a typo in the Treasure Explosion passive that incorrectly stated "X" instead of "%".
[*] The Treasure Explosion value has been changed to 1% per level, up from 0.1%.
[*] The Rain of Rain passive cannot be repeated.
[*] The Longer Bosses passive now extends the time up to 50 seconds.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello again!

Here's our second patch of the day. A big thank you to the players in the game's Discord and the forum for suggesting new features and reporting bugs. This update includes:

[list]
[*] From Level 75 to Level 300, every 25 levels now guarantee at least one Ghost Boss encounter.
[*] When rolling a Legendary or Epic upgrade, the button will now be disabled for 1 second to prevent accidental over-rerolling.
[*] The current version of the game is now displayed in the settings menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where both Gold and Ether were not always increased by the Gold Gained / Ether Gained stats.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Headsman ability to activate only on monsters with 20% or less HP instead of the intended 50%.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the Headsman ability to be activated on Bosses.
[/list]
